title: Ardys
summary: King of Lydia, son of Gyges; the Cimmerians took Sardis in his reign (Herodotus 1.15).
description: Added from the Herodotus import (The Histories, tr. Rawlinson). Herodotus gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not BC years, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Herodotus is display-only and gives none).

reign.date: “In his reign the Cimmerians, driven from their homes by the nomads of Scythia, entered Asia and captured Sardis, all but the citadel.”
reign.citation: Herodotus, Histories 1.15 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 7 (PDF p. 9)
reign.note: Synchronism: the Cimmerian capture of Sardis falls in the reign of Ardys.

reign.date: “He reigned forty-nine years, and was succeeded by his son, Sadyattes, who reigned twelve years.”
reign.citation: Herodotus, Histories 1.15 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 7 (PDF p. 9)
